title: Clean the actual worked backing rather than only the patch exterior
statement: A10x8mm patch cut from12mm generic film is clamped by curved hot tools against the finite piston wall, requiring about33N at introduced.414MPa. Finite coating and fresh release web are paid. After cooling, peeling and gauging, a second service movement exposes the previously heated backing for wiping. Corrected follower clearance rises from.20mm to2.20mm to admit a.5mm wiper/web, with a120mm stage covering99mm service span. Adhesion, coating release, thermal contact and repeatable access are proposed hardware operations, not solved by the software state.
